# Azure Cosmos DB Migration Guide for Elasticsearch Users

## What Changed

Azure Cosmos DB’s full-text search capabilities can improve price performance and simplify application architecture by consolidating operational data and search in a single service. For customers currently using Elasticsearch, these capabilities create a practical path to bringing operational data and search together in Azure Cosmos DB, particularly when the application’s data already lives there.
